  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows positive bias (e.g., >0.00) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent history shows mean reversion toward lower prices.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices if sentiment is neutral or negative (e.g., <0.00).",
    "Apply lag correction: if true outcome is significantly lower than forecast, adjust next period’s forecast downward by 3-5%.",
    "Cap forecast spikes above 68.00 if sentiment is negative or recent history shows downward momentum.",
    "If forecast overshoots true outcome by >10%, reduce subsequent forecast by 10-15% to avoid overcorrection.",
    "Use sentiment as a momentum filter: if sentiment >0.25, expect price to stabilize or slightly rise; if < -0.25, expect correction."
  ]
}
